_comment: Federation join-strategy config (Epic 5 / PRD §12, W9). Sets how `graph-sync --global` joins sibling subgraphs onto shared contract nodes. See docs/concepts/pipeline-v3/adr-federation-identity.md for the rationale.
rationale: Twindle (the test-bench rubric app) and the first sibling set are built as ONE deployed SST backend — siblings share table ARNs and the API origin — so the cheap resource-identity join is correct and exercised first. Switch to 'schema-shape' only when a sibling is confirmed to be a SEPARATE deployment of the same schema.

strategies.resource-identity: Join on shared AWS resource identity (table/bucket/queue ARN). Use when siblings share ONE deployed backend.
strategies.schema-shape: Join on shape: table fields + primaryIndex, endpoint method+path, event name. Use when siblings are separate deployments of the same schema.
